note: The cottage's description, seen on arrival, shows the inked-over 5 on the tide schedule, giving away the changed-schedule clue before it is found.

A snug stone cottage sits at the foot of the lighthouse. A kettle hums on the stove and a ship's clock ticks on the shelf. A tide schedule is pinned to the wall by the door; last night's low tide reads 5:00 a.m. in fresh, dark ink over a scratched-out number.
